purpose.title: What Topiqu does
purpose.description: Topiqu is an AI content operations platform. It helps businesses research, create, review, translate, publish, and continuously improve articles on their own websites.
purpose.gscDescription: If you connect this optional integration, Topiqu receives read-only access to clicks, impressions, CTR, and average-position data. It uses the data for performance reporting and to flag possible opportunities; it does not guarantee search results and cannot change your website settings in Google.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about creating, translating and publishing content with Topiqu.
faq.cta_desc: Write to us and we will help.

items.q: What can I create with Topiqu?
items.a: You can write and edit articles yourself, generate drafts with AI, add media, tables and polls, and manage multiple language versions from one workspace.

items.q: Can I use Topiqu on my own domain?
items.a: Yes. Eligible plans can connect a verified custom domain. Topiqu guides you through the required DNS record and verifies ownership before activating it.
Only when you configure automatic publishing. You can otherwise review and edit every AI-generated draft before it goes live, and you can display an AI-content disclosure.

items.q: How can I publish Topiqu content on my website?
items.a: You can use a hosted Topiqu site, connect a custom domain, synchronize articles with the Topiqu Sync plugin for WordPress, or consume them through the External API.
Yes. Topiqu supports multiple language versions, AI-assisted translation and a review workflow. Readers are directed to the correct translated article URL when one is available.
